args.name: sfluxzen
args.note: every thread stores its word on every path (constant bands included)

branches.inactive_reason: Integer layer indices; on the taken branch the word is 0 or a table constant.
When the trajectory is clamped the tangent of specparm is 0 (the clamp value is a constant); otherwise the exact partial. 0 clamped points on the captured launches.
Piecewise-linear interpolation, continuous across bin edges; the frozen bin gives the one-sided slope, exact off the edge.

limiters: specparm clamp at oneminus: frozen coefficient (tangent 0 when clamped); interpolation bin frozen from the trajectory

refusal.domain: column amounts finite; A + r*B != 0 (the forward divides 0/0 there); bin js in 1..mult (a negative amount puts it outside); every partial and written derivative word finite

precondition: the five column-amount arrays and sfluxzen are distinct allocations. TL: one thread per (col, g-point) owns its word. AD: one thread per column (first ncol threads of the forward geometry) walks the 112 g-points in order and sums into at most 14 (gas, layer) slots in double, each written once: deterministic, no atomics.
precision: the f32 primal words the derivative needs (specparm, clamp flag, js, the two table words) are formed as the forward forms them (__f*_rn, --fmad=false --ftz=false; the harness-only __check is bitwise to the forward image); partials in double; one rounding to f32 per written derivative word (the glue-row rule)
